MeasuredHornObstruction:
∃ select : PEqualNP.Search.CNF → List ℕ, ∃ pick : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) pick ∧
      (∀ φ, pick (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause ((select φ).map (fun x => (x,true)))) ∧
      (∀ φ, select φ = [] ↔ ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ φ, (select φ).length ≤ 2) ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (xs : List ℕ), (∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter (fun l => l.2 && decide (l.1 ∉ xs))).length ≤ 1) →
        select φ ≠ [] → ∃ x ∈ select φ, x ∈ xs
MeasuredObstructionWalk:
∀ (G D : Language Bool) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hsub : ∀ φ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ψ.Sublist φ → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ G)
    (hsat : ∀ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ G → (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable ψ))
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (select : PEqualNP.Search.CNF → List ℕ) (pick : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hpick : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) pick)
    (hpickSpec : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, pick (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause ((select φ).map (fun x => (x,true))))
    (hclear : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, select φ = [] ↔ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G)
    (hwidth : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (select φ).length ≤ a)
    (hhit : ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (xs : List ℕ), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G →
      select φ ≠ [] → ∃ x ∈ select φ, x ∈ xs),
    let pair := fun (p q : List Bool) => List.replicate p.length true ++ false :: (p ++ q)
    ∃ walk : List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool walk ∧
      ∀ (limit : List Bool) (φ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), 1 ≤ limit.length → ψ.Sublist φ →
        ((∃ j < limit.length, walk (pair limit (pair (List.replicate j true)
          (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ)))) = true) ↔
         (∃ k : ℕ, (2*a)^k ≤ limit.length ∧ ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
           PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable ψ)
ExactObstructionBudgetSAT:
∀ (G D : Language Bool) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hsub : ∀ φ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ψ.Sublist φ → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ G)
    (hsat : ∀ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ G → (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable ψ))
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (select : PEqualNP.Search.CNF → List ℕ) (pick : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hpick : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) pick)
    (hpickSpec : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, pick (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause ((select φ).map (fun x => (x,true))))
    (hclear : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, select φ = [] ↔ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G)
    (hwidth : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (select φ).length ≤ a)
    (hhit : ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (xs : List ℕ), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G →
      select φ ≠ [] → ∃ x ∈ select φ, x ∈ xs) (q : Polynomial ℕ),
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ∃ k : ℕ, (2*a)^k ≤ q.eval x.length + 1 ∧ ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∃ k : ℕ, (2*a)^k ≤ q.eval x.length + 1 ∧ ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactHornObstructionBudgetSAT:
∀ (q : Polynomial ℕ),
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ∃ k : ℕ, 4^k ≤ q.eval x.length + 1 ∧ ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
        ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter (fun l => l.2 && decide (l.1 ∉ xs))).length ≤ 1} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∃ k : ℕ, 4^k ≤ q.eval x.length + 1 ∧ ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
        ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter (fun l => l.2 && decide (l.1 ∉ xs))).length ≤ 1) ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ObstructionBudgetSATSearch:
∀ (G D : Language Bool) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hsub : ∀ φ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ψ.Sublist φ → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ G)
    (hsat : ∀ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ G → (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable ψ))
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (select : PEqualNP.Search.CNF → List ℕ) (pick : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hpick : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) pick)
    (hpickSpec : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, pick (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause ((select φ).map (fun x => (x,true))))
    (hclear : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, select φ = [] ↔ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G)
    (hwidth : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (select φ).length ≤ a)
    (hhit : ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (xs : List ℕ), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G →
      select φ ≠ [] → ∃ x ∈ select φ, x ∈ xs)
    (hshort : ∀ (φ extra : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), (∀ c ∈ extra, c.length ≤ 1) → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ ++ extra) ∈ G)
    (q : Polynomial ℕ),
    ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∃ k : ℕ, (2*a)^k ≤ q.eval (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length + 1 ∧ ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.filter (fun l => decide (l.1 ∉ xs)))) ∈ G) →
        PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → ∃ vs : List ℕ,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length ≤ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ vs)) φ = true
